tier_0.line_1: Malgrath: Keep them upstairs, Grak. I cannot fight again.
tier_0.line_2: Malgrath: I said the gold by the steps. Put that back.

tier_1.line_1: Malgrath: One entrance held. Check the others.

tier_2.line_1: Malgrath: More timber? What happened to the last lot?

tier_3.line_1: Malgrath: I heard the guns stop. How many came back?

tier_4.line_1: Malgrath: Leave the water here. I can lift my own head.
